alt: Sunrise light on Lake Atitlán with the dark outlines of volcanoes across the water
caption: Lake Atitlán at sunrise, with fishing boats on the water and the volcano silhouettes beyond. This is the setting for days 5-6, when the route drops from the highlands to the lake villages that the Tz'utujil and Kaqchikel people live in.

commonsFile: File:Arco de Santa Catalina Antigua Guatemala edit2.jpg
alt: Yellow Santa Catalina Arch spanning a cobbled street in Antigua with a volcano behind
caption: The yellow Santa Catalina Arch on a cobbled Antigua street, with Volcán de Agua rising behind it. It frames the first-light walk on day 2 through Antigua's ruined convents, and again on the Lent Sunday of day 3.

commonsFile: File:Fuego volcano in Guatemala erupting at night in 2017.jpg
alt: Fuego volcano throwing glowing material above its cone against the night sky
caption: Fuego erupting at night in November 2017, with incandescent material thrown above the cone. This is the show that the cold overnight camp on Acatenango (day 4) is built around, if the post-eruption ascent ban has been lifted.

alt: Colourful stalls and shoppers in the crowded Chichicastenango market
caption: Morning shoppers and stalls in the market at Chichicastenango, in the Quiché highlands. The Thursday market is the centre of day 7, alongside the K'iche' ceremonies on the Santo Tomás church steps.

commonsFile: File:Atitlan lake from San Juan La Laguna harbour.jpg
location: San Juan La Laguna, Lake Atitlán
alt: Boats moored in the harbour at San Juan La Laguna with Lake Atitlán and its volcanoes beyond
caption: Lake Atitlán seen from the harbour at San Juan La Laguna, with moored boats in the foreground. The village is the lakeside base for day 6 and its weaving and natural-dye cooperatives, reached by shared lancha from Panajachel.

commonsFile: File:Santiaguito y Santa María - Guatemala Nov 2008.jpg
location: Santa María volcano and Santiaguito, Quetzaltenango
alt: Smoking Santiaguito lava dome at the foot of the cone of Santa María volcano
caption: Santa María volcano with the Santiaguito lava dome smoking on its flank, seen from the lowlands to the south. The pre-dawn climb on day 8 looks down into this dome, one of the most continuously active in the world.

alt: Temple IV, a steep stepped pyramid, rising above the forest canopy at Tikal
caption: Temple IV rising above the jungle canopy at Tikal, in the Petén lowlands. The tallest structure in the park is the sunrise viewpoint of days 10-11, after a night camping inside Tikal National Park.

alt: Forest and lake seen from a high pyramid platform at Yaxhá
caption: A view across the forest and Laguna Yaxhá from the top of a pyramid at Yaxhá, in Petén. The sunset stop of day 11, a quieter Maya city than Tikal, with a lake outlook and few other visitors.

commonsFile: File:Ruins of the Convent of Santa Clara.jpg
location: Convent of Santa Clara, Antigua Guatemala
alt: Roofless stone arcades and courtyard of the ruined Convent of Santa Clara in Antigua
caption: The roofless arcades of the Convent of Santa Clara in Antigua, left in ruins after the earthquakes of the 1700s. It is one of the convents on the day 2 walking route through the old capital.

location: Fuego and Acatenango volcanoes, Chimaltenango and Sacatepéquez
alt: The twin cones of Fuego and Acatenango seen through palms, with a small ash plume rising beside them
caption: The twin cones of Fuego and Acatenango seen from the lowlands, with a small ash plume drifting up from Fuego. They are the pair behind day 4: the overnight camp is on Acatenango facing Fuego, and the summit climb on day 5 is up Acatenango.

commonsFile: File:Mayan 'Saint' Maximón with offerings, guarded by a brotherhood in Santiago Atitlán, Guatemala.jpg
alt: The effigy of Maximón seated with offerings and tended by a brotherhood in Santiago Atitlán
caption: The Maximón effigy with offerings of tobacco and alcohol, kept by a brotherhood in Santiago Atitlán. It is the stop for the Tz'utujil town on day 6, to be visited with a local guide, asking before photographing anyone.

alt: Steaming thermal pool surrounded by forested slopes at Fuentes Georginas
caption: The thermal pools of Fuentes Georginas, in cloud forest at about 2,800 m above Zunil. They are the afternoon soak on day 8, after the pre-dawn Santa María climb.

commonsFile: File:Isla de Flores desde el Lago Petén Itzá.jpg
alt: Flores island with its hillside church and waterfront buildings reflected in Lake Petén Itzá
caption: Flores, the island town on Lake Petén Itzá that is the base for the Petén leg. It is the sunset walk on day 9, the kayak and swim morning on day 12, and the starting point for Tikal and Yaxhá.

alt: Temple I and the North Acropolis around the Great Plaza at Tikal, seen from Temple II
caption: Temple I and the North Acropolis around Tikal's Great Plaza, seen from Temple II. The plaza is the first stop of the full day at Tikal on day 10, before the climb to Temple IV.
